scope.summary: Implement per-garment fit property controls (ease offsets per body region, tightness blend factor) stored on tailor_garment_fits rows, and expose real-time Stress, Strain, and Pressure heatmap visualization layers in the Tailor viewport for the fitted garment
acceptance_criteria: GarmentFitProperties type (ease_overrides: EaseOverrideMap, tightness_blend: f32 in [0,1]) is storable on tailor_garment_fits as a fit_props_json JSONB column
POST /api/tailor/garments/{gar_id}/fit-properties accepts GarmentFitProperties and updates the fit row for the current active avatar

The solver computes per-vertex stress (stretch ratio vs rest), strain (scalar from the stretch constraint lambda), and pressure (collision force magnitude) after each sim run and stores them as a Float32Array sidecar in tailor_garment_fits
The Tailor viewport exposes a heatmap_mode query param (stress | strain | pressure | off) that colorizes the garment mesh from the stored per-vertex sidecar
A model can read the heatmap summary (region max/mean values) via GET /api/tailor/garments/{gar_id}/fit-heatmap for self-correction
cargo test fit_heatmap::test_stress_computed_after_sim and fit_heatmap::test_strain_within_range both pass

All operator-facing scope is implemented in src/frontend/handshake_native with native wgpu/egui, AccessKit author_id, Argus inspection/steering/capture, and no Tailor React, Tauri-command, WebView, data-testid-only, or rendered-PNG frontend path.

The exact TailorSurfaceDescriptor row MT-432 enumerates every route, pane, control author_id, dynamic entity-key rule, action, state, help anchor, permission, undo policy, receipt, and command binding; wildcard-only evidence is rejected.

Applicable blank, loading, populated, stale/conflict, cancelled, failed, retry, permission, keyboard/focus, narrow/4K/DPI, overlap/clipping, and no-focus-steal states are covered by the registry-derived Argus matrix.

Fit-map behavior distinguishes Global and Fabric modes, uses each fabric's tensile limits, exposes eight configurable bands, dominant warp/weft/bias direction, actual stretch and force ratio, and supports point probing with numeric non-color output.
scope.risk_if_missed: Operators and models have no feedback on whether a garment is too tight or too loose in specific body regions after fitting. This is MD's primary fit-quality feedback tool; without it, fit quality can only be assessed by visual inspection of the 3D render, eliminating actionable iteration on fit.

risks: Broad MT scope can hide multiple review targets.
Markdown MT lists may disagree with packet-declared active/next MT truth.
Receipt routing may target an old MT if contract identity is omitted.
minimum_controls: Exactly one primary proof target per MT unless the packet records why not.
MT identity must be stable and referenced by receipt correlation.
Generated projection drift must not wake Coder or Validator by itself.

surfaces: native Tailor pane and applicable editor, viewport, browser, timeline, or status surface

target_entries: Tailor UserManual > Body fitting, sizing, and garment transfer

hbr_int_009_tier_obligations.reason: This MT owns authoritative, job, or external-tool lifecycle events and must project the same event_id, run_id, actor_id, and correlation_id from EventLedger into Flight Recorder.
This MT must wire the shared internal_diagnostics API for its native, job, device, solver-run, or DCC failure modes with bounded structured evidence.
Long-running, native, or external-process work must register bounded progress and child/process identity with the shared Palmistry watcher; Tailor must not fork a watcher.

required_changes_before_execution: Reconcile refit/redrape, friction overrides, warm starts, topology lock, fit maps, batch jobs, determinism, and FIT_VALID evidence with the new solver tiers and final-contact promotion rule.
Replace legacy app/src or app/src-tauri targets with the native Handshake shell and native Tailor paths.
Feed the shared Problems system and provide legends, units, numeric probes, stable entity links, and non-color alternatives.
Added gui_obligation, user_manual_obligation, and HBR-INT-009 tier obligations from the current MT template without removing original scope.
Consume the signed technical refinement, canonical command/surface registries, classified HBR tiers, and task-oriented UserManual contract before execution.

requirements: Resolve Principal, AuthenticatedSession and AccessSpace before every resource read or mutation.
Use PostgreSQL RLS/FORCE RLS and ResourceBroker-backed artifact/file handles; UI filtering is never the security boundary.
Derived resources preserve the intersection of source access scopes and must not leak existence through counts, search, previews, logs, traces, caches, diagnostics, exports or model context.
